title: Package set declares no target framework
description: packages.config declares a packages.config with no `targetFramework`. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a packages.config with no `targetFramework`.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a packages.config with no `targetFramework`.
limitation: It matches a packages.config with no `targetFramework` in the parsed packages.config; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
